items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: on some of the dates with Quincy, he played the drums. And when, with Peggy Lee.

ctx.x: ‘Cause he maybe he’s a studio drummer so he’s doing a lot of work.

No, he was… He was… on some of the dates with Quincy, he played the drums. And when, with Peggy Lee. And when I talked too much, he said, “Hey, Tits, shut up and play your chrome sandwich.” That’s Grady. [laughs] See, you wanted anecdotes. You got it. “Hey, Tits. Shut up, man, and play your chrome sandwich.” So that’s Grady. That’s Grady. [laughs] I hope he’s okay, because he must be up in, in those numbers. Not far from mine. [laughs]
And then I saw that you had done a date with Dannie Richmond, of course known with Charles Mingus.
